# Load packages. install if necessary: e.g. install.packages("example")

library(ggtree)
library(glue)
library(dplyr)
library(ggstance)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(phytools)


######################
### ITS LSU TREE #####
######################

#read in tree and data table
tree <- read.tree("its_lsu.nwk")
tree <- midpoint.root(tree)
df1 <- read.csv("sample_table.csv")


#Add italics and put together tip label
df1 <- dplyr::mutate(df1, lab = glue("'   '~italic({Genus})~italic({Species})~~{Herbarium}~on~italic({Host_genus})~italic({Host_species})~'('~italic({Host_family})~')'"))


p<- ggtree(tree) %<+% df1 + ##adjust right value to widen or narrow tree
   geom_tiplab(
      aes(label = lab), #format excel with a Color column
      parse = TRUE,
      align = FALSE,
      size = 4, key_glyph = "rect"
    ) +geom_treescale(x=.05, y=-1) + xlim(0,.5)


### Add bootstrap labels

q <- ggtree(tree)
d <- q$data
d <- d[!d$isTip,]
d$label2 <- as.numeric(d$label)
d70 <- d[d$label2>70,]

# One  label overlaps with tree. Subset label.

d70b <- d70[20, ]
d70 <- d70[c(1:19,21:22),]
d70b$label3 <- d70b$label2

p <-p %<+%d70 +geom_text2(aes(label = label2), size = 3.5, hjust = 1.25, vjust = -.25)
p <-p %<+%d70b +geom_text2(aes(label = label3), size = 3.5, hjust = .35,  vjust = -1)

### BUSCO TREE #######
######################


tree2 <- read.tree('busco.tree')
df2 <- read.csv('sample_table_busco.csv')
df2 <- dplyr::mutate(df2, lab = glue("' '~italic({Genus})~italic({Species})~~{Accession}"))

p2 <- ggtree(tree2)  %<+% df2 + ##adjust right value to widen or narrow tree
   geom_tiplab(
      aes(label = lab), #format excel with a Color column
      parse = TRUE,
      align = FALSE,
      size = 4, key_glyph = "rect"
    ) +geom_treescale(x=.05, y=-.5) + xlim(0,1)
